errors.text_span: Линейната диаграма
errors.evidence: The chart is a bar chart, not a line chart as stated.

errors.text_span: достигайки максимална стойност от 60 GB
errors.evidence: The y-axis scale goes above 60 GB, as the 'Full FT' bar reaches approximately 70 GB. 60 GB is the highest labeled tick mark, not the maximum value of the data.

errors.text_span: Най-високата стълба, съответстваща на Full FT, е с височина около 60 GB
errors.evidence: The bar for 'Full FT' clearly exceeds the 60 GB line, reaching a value of approximately 70 GB.

errors.text_span: а най-ниската стълба, съответстваща на Ours
errors.evidence: The lowest bar in the chart corresponds to 'QLoRA' (approx. 13 GB), not 'Ours' (approx. 22 GB).

errors.text_span: Раззултата на оста се нарича
errors.evidence: This phrase is ungrammatical and nonsensical in Bulgarian. It likely intended to say 'The axis label is' ('Етикетът на оста е').

errors.text_span: Под стълбите за Full FT и MTL-FT има други стълби
errors.evidence: The bars are arranged side-by-side along the horizontal axis, not 'under' each other.

errors.text_span: подредени от най-ниската до най-високата
errors.evidence: The last four bars (TAG, LoRA, QLoRA, Ours) are not sorted by height. Their approximate heights are 22, 22, 13, and 22 GB, which is not an ascending order.
The description does not mention the title of the chart, 'QLoRA'.

The description fails to mention the different colors of the bars. The 'Ours' bar is green, while all other bars are orange, which is a key visual feature used to distinguish the proposed method from the baselines.

errors.text_span: All bars are colored differently—Full FT is orange, MTL-FT is yellow, TAG is green, LoRA is blue, QLoRA is dark orange, and Ours is light green
errors.evidence: The chart does not use this color scheme. Five of the bars are orange, and one ('Ours') is green. The description invents multiple distinct colors for the bars.

errors.text_span: ordered alphabetically from left to right
errors.evidence: The categories on the x-axis (Full FT, MTL-FT, TAG, LoRA, QLoRA, Ours) are not in alphabetical order.

errors.text_span: no bars are visually emphasized beyond their height
errors.evidence: The 'Ours' bar is visually emphasized with a distinct green color and a bolded label, which is contrary to the description's claim.

errors.text_span: reaches approximately 60 GB
errors.evidence: The bar for 'Full FT' is significantly taller than 60 GB, reaching approximately 75 GB.

errors.text_span: “LoRA” at approximately 15 GB
errors.evidence: The bar for 'LoRA' is approximately 22 GB, not 15 GB. The description seems to have confused the value for 'LoRA' with that of 'QLoRA'.

errors.text_span: “QLoRA” at approximately 30 GB
errors.evidence: The bar for 'QLoRA' is the shortest, at approximately 13 GB. The stated value of 30 GB is incorrect by more than double.

errors.text_span: ranging from 0 to 65
errors.evidence: The y-axis labels show a range from 0 to 60, not 65. While the data exceeds 60, the labeled axis range is described incorrectly.
The description does not mention the title of the chart, "QLoRA", which provides the overall context for the comparison.

errors.text_span: Full FT, MTL-FT, TAG, TAG, LoRA, LoRA und Ours
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly lists the categories on the x-axis. It repeats "TAG" and "LoRA" while completely omitting "QLoRA". The correct labels are "Full FT", "MTL-FT", "TAG", "LoRA", "QLoRA", and "Ours".

errors.text_span: etwa 60 GB
errors.evidence: The description states that the "Full FT" bar reaches about 60 GB, but the bar clearly extends above the 60 GB line to approximately 75 GB.

errors.text_span: während der niedrigste Balken, der „LoRA“ darstellt
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies "LoRA" as the lowest bar. The lowest bar in the chart corresponds to "QLoRA" (approx. 12 GB), not "LoRA" (approx. 22 GB).

errors.text_span: einen Wert von etwa 20 GB erreicht
errors.evidence: The value for the "LoRA" bar is stated as about 20 GB, but it is visibly higher, at approximately 22 GB.

errors.text_span: etwa 30 GB
errors.evidence: The description states the value for "TAG" is about 30 GB, but the bar's height is approximately 22 GB.

errors.text_span: mit Höhen von etwa 15 GB bzw. 15 GB
errors.evidence: The description claims the heights for "LoRA" and "Ours" are both about 15 GB. In the chart, both bars have a height of approximately 22 GB.

errors.text_span: Alle Balken sind in absteigender Reihenfolge sortiert
errors.evidence: The description claims the bars are sorted in descending order, which is false. For example, the bar for "QLoRA" (approx. 12 GB) is lower than the bars for "TAG", "LoRA", and "Ours" (all approx. 22 GB) that come after it in the sequence.
The description fails to mention the color difference between the bars. The bar for "Ours" is green, while all other bars are orange, which is a deliberate visual distinction.
